payload.primary_text: 人哋都走晒，我哋仲喺度等。
payload.transliteration: Yàhn deih dōu jáu saai, ngóh deih juhng hái douh dáng.
payload.translation: People have all left, but we are still waiting here.
payload.target_breakdown: 人哋 means “people/others” and functions as the subject of the sentence.

payload.transliteration: Dím gáai néih gām yaht gam chìh?
payload.translation: Why are you so late today?
payload.target_breakdown: 點解 is an interrogative adverb meaning “why” and introduces the question.

payload.transliteration: Kéuih jūng yū chēut sēng daap ngóh.
payload.translation: He finally spoke up to answer me.
payload.target_breakdown: 出聲 is a verb phrase meaning “to speak up/say” and is followed by 答我.

payload.primary_text: 呢度遊客好多，行得好慢。
payload.transliteration: Nī douh yàuh haak hóu dō, hàhng dāk hóu maahn.
payload.translation: There are lots of tourists here, and they walk very slowly.
payload.target_breakdown: 遊客 is a noun meaning “tourist(s)” and serves as the topic/subject of the clause.

payload.transliteration: Néih bún syū fong jó hái bīn douh?
payload.translation: Where did you put your book?
payload.target_breakdown: 邊度 is an interrogative locative meaning “where” and follows the preposition 喺.

payload.transliteration: Kéuih jeh máahn juhk gūng, ngaam jauh fan gaau.
payload.translation: He works at night and sleeps in the afternoon.
payload.target_breakdown: 做工 is a verb phrase meaning “to work/do a job” and is the main predicate.

payload.transliteration: Ngóh háu gok, séung yám séui.
payload.translation: I am thirsty and want to drink water.
payload.target_breakdown: 飲 is a transitive verb meaning “to drink” and takes 水 as its object.

payload.transliteration: Kéuih m̀h yám jáu, jingh haih yám chàh.
payload.translation: He doesn't drink alcohol; he only drinks tea.
payload.target_breakdown: 酒 is a noun meaning “alcohol/wine” and is the object of 飲.

payload.primary_text: 我生日嗰日，佢送我玫瑰花。
payload.transliteration: Ngóh sāng yaht gó yaht, kéuih sung ngóh muih gwāi fā.
payload.translation: On my birthday, he gave me roses.
payload.cloze_text: 我生日嗰日，佢___我玫瑰花。
payload.target_breakdown: 送 is a verb meaning “to give (as a gift)” and takes 我 as indirect object and 玫瑰花 as direct object.

payload.transliteration: Gām nìhn ngóh deih heui āu jāu léuih hàhng.
payload.translation: This year we are going to Europe for a trip.
payload.target_breakdown: 今年 is a time noun meaning “this year” and modifies the whole clause.
